title: Vestibular Evoked Myogenic Potential: A New Device Propose
brief_summary: The bioelectrical responses of muscle, evoked by sound, obtained with a device considered the gold standard (widely used in clinics and hospitals) are similar to those obtained with a new device developed
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* hearing thresholds equal to or less than 20 dB HL with differences between the ears, by frequency, equal to or less than 10 dB.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Occupational noise exposure
* Ear surgeries
* More than three ear infections in the current year
* Use of ototoxic medication
* Tinnitus, vertigo, dizziness or other vestibular-cochlear diseases
* Systemic diseases that may contribute to cochlear-vestibular pathologies, such as hypertension and dyslipidemia
* Hormonal diseases
study_population: Adults, Normal Hearing, Normal Vestibular fuction,
